units_allocated.label: Units allocated
units_allocated.spec: Premium after the allocation rate, converted to units at the month's unit price.

source.code:
def units_allocated(premium, allocation_rate, unit_price):
    """Units allocated.

    Premium after the allocation rate, converted to units at the month's unit price.

    Units: units per policy
    Timing: start of month
    Format: units
    """
    return premium * allocation_rate / unit_price

units_after_alloc.label: Units after allocation
units_after_alloc.spec: Opening units plus the units allocated this month.

source.code:
def units_after_alloc(units_bop, units_allocated):
    """Units after allocation.

    Opening units plus the units allocated this month.

    Units: units per policy
    Timing: during month, after allocation
    Format: units
    """
    return units_bop + units_allocated

units_amc.label: AMC units
units_amc.spec: Monthly management charge deducted in units, after allocation, capped at a fixed number of units.
assumed: the charge is on units after the same month's allocation

source.code:
def units_amc(units_after_alloc, amc_pm, amc_cap_units):
    """AMC units.

    Monthly management charge deducted in units, after allocation, capped at a fixed number of units.

    Units: units per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: units
    Assumed: the charge is on units after the same month's allocation
    """
    return np.minimum(units_after_alloc * amc_pm, amc_cap_units)

units_eop.label: Closing units
units_eop.spec: Units after allocation less the management charge.

source.code:
def units_eop(units_after_alloc, units_amc):
    """Closing units.

    Units after allocation less the management charge.

    Units: units per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: units
    """
    return units_after_alloc - units_amc

deaths.label: Deaths
deaths.spec: Expected deaths in the month, from the opening in-force and the monthly mortality rate.
assumed: deaths occur before lapses within the month

source.code:
def deaths(in_force_bop, mortality_pm):
    """Deaths.

    Expected deaths in the month, from the opening in-force and the monthly mortality rate.

    Units: proportion of policies
    Timing: end of month, first decrement
    Format: rate
    Assumed: deaths occur before lapses within the month
    """
    return in_force_bop * mortality_pm

lapses.label: Lapses
lapses.spec: Expected lapses among the survivors of the month's deaths.

source.code:
def lapses(in_force_bop, deaths, lapse_pm):
    """Lapses.

    Expected lapses among the survivors of the month's deaths.

    Units: proportion of policies
    Timing: end of month, second decrement
    Format: rate
    """
    return (in_force_bop - deaths) * lapse_pm

in_force_eop.label: Closing in force
in_force_eop.spec: Opening in-force less deaths and lapses.

source.code:
def in_force_eop(in_force_bop, deaths, lapses):
    """Closing in force.

    Opening in-force less deaths and lapses.

    Units: proportion of policies
    Timing: end of month
    Format: number
    """
    return in_force_bop - deaths - lapses

fund_value_eop.label: Fund value
fund_value_eop.spec: Closing units valued at the month's unit price.

source.code:
def fund_value_eop(units_eop, unit_price):
    """Fund value.

    Closing units valued at the month's unit price.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return units_eop * unit_price

premium_income.label: Premium income
premium_income.spec: Premium received from policies in force at the end of the month.

source.code:
def premium_income(premium, in_force_eop):
    """Premium income.

    Premium received from policies in force at the end of the month.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: start of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return premium * in_force_eop

allocation_margin.label: Allocation margin
allocation_margin.spec: The part of the premium not allocated to units, kept by the insurer.

source.code:
def allocation_margin(premium, allocation_rate, in_force_eop):
    """Allocation margin.

    The part of the premium not allocated to units, kept by the insurer.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: start of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return premium * (1 - allocation_rate) * in_force_eop

amc_income.label: AMC income
amc_income.spec: The management charge taken in units, valued at the unit price.

source.code:
def amc_income(units_amc, unit_price, in_force_eop):
    """AMC income.

    The management charge taken in units, valued at the unit price.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return units_amc * unit_price * in_force_eop

maintenance_expense.label: Maintenance expense
maintenance_expense.spec: Monthly policy maintenance cost, paid while the policy is in force.

source.code:
def maintenance_expense(expense_pm, in_force_eop):
    """Maintenance expense.

    Monthly policy maintenance cost, paid while the policy is in force.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: start of month
    Format: amount
    Assumed: expenses do not inflate
    """
    return -expense_pm * in_force_eop

acquisition_expense.label: Acquisition expense
acquisition_expense.spec: A percentage of premium plus a fixed amount, charged in the first month only.

source.code:
def acquisition_expense(premium, acq_expense_pct, acq_expense_fixed):
    """Acquisition expense.

    A percentage of premium plus a fixed amount, charged in the first month only.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: start of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return -(premium * acq_expense_pct + acq_expense_fixed)

sum_at_risk.label: Sum at risk
sum_at_risk.spec: Sum assured less the fund value, never below zero.

source.code:
def sum_at_risk(sum_assured, fund_value_eop):
    """Sum at risk.

    Sum assured less the fund value, never below zero.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return np.maximum(sum_assured - fund_value_eop, 0)

death_strain.label: Death strain
death_strain.spec: Cost of deaths in the month: deaths times the sum at risk.

source.code:
def death_strain(sum_at_risk, deaths):
    """Death strain.

    Cost of deaths in the month: deaths times the sum at risk.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return -sum_at_risk * deaths

gross_profit.label: Gross profit
gross_profit.spec: Allocation margin and charges less expenses and death strain.

source.code:
def gross_profit(allocation_margin, amc_income, maintenance_expense, acquisition_expense, death_strain):
    """Gross profit.

    Allocation margin and charges less expenses and death strain.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return allocation_margin + amc_income + maintenance_expense + acquisition_expense + death_strain

ceded_death_strain.label: Ceded death strain
ceded_death_strain.spec: The reinsurer's share of the death strain.

source.code:
def ceded_death_strain(death_strain, qs_share):
    """Ceded death strain.

    The reinsurer's share of the death strain.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return death_strain * qs_share

retained_death_strain.label: Retained death strain
retained_death_strain.spec: Death strain less the ceded part.

source.code:
def retained_death_strain(death_strain, ceded_death_strain):
    """Retained death strain.

    Death strain less the ceded part.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return death_strain - ceded_death_strain

reinsurance_premium.label: Reinsurance premium
reinsurance_premium.spec: Reinsurance rate applied to the ceded share of the sum at risk.

source.code:
def reinsurance_premium(sum_at_risk, qs_share, reins_rate_pm):
    """Reinsurance premium.

    Reinsurance rate applied to the ceded share of the sum at risk.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    Assumed: premium is paid in arrears
    """
    return -sum_at_risk * qs_share * reins_rate_pm

net_profit.label: Net profit
net_profit.spec: Gross profit after the reinsurance recovery and premium.

source.code:
def net_profit(gross_profit, ceded_death_strain, reinsurance_premium):
    """Net profit.

    Gross profit after the reinsurance recovery and premium.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: end of month
    Format: amount
    """
    return gross_profit - ceded_death_strain + reinsurance_premium

pv_gross_profit.label: PV of gross profit
pv_gross_profit.spec: Gross profit discounted at the monthly rate.

source.code:
def pv_gross_profit(gross_profit, disc_pm):
    """PV of gross profit.

    Gross profit discounted at the monthly rate.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: whole projection
    Format: amount
    """
    return np.sum(gross_profit / (1 + disc_pm) ** np.arange(1, len(gross_profit) + 1))

pv_net_profit.label: PV of net profit
pv_net_profit.spec: Net profit discounted at the monthly rate.

source.code:
def pv_net_profit(net_profit, disc_pm):
    """PV of net profit.

    Net profit discounted at the monthly rate.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: whole projection
    Format: amount
    """
    return np.sum(net_profit / (1 + disc_pm) ** np.arange(1, len(net_profit) + 1))

pv_premium.label: PV of premium
pv_premium.spec: Premium income discounted at the monthly rate.

source.code:
def pv_premium(premium_income, disc_pm):
    """PV of premium.

    Premium income discounted at the monthly rate.

    Units: amount per policy
    Timing: whole projection
    Format: amount
    """
    return np.sum(premium_income / (1 + disc_pm) ** np.arange(1, len(premium_income) + 1))

profit_margin.label: Profit margin
profit_margin.spec: PV of net profit as a share of PV of premium.

source.code:
def profit_margin(pv_net_profit, pv_premium):
    """Profit margin.

    PV of net profit as a share of PV of premium.

    Units: ratio
    Timing: whole projection
    Format: percent
    """
    return pv_net_profit / pv_premium

irr_pm.label: IRR per month
irr_pm.spec: The monthly rate at which net profit has a present value of zero.

source.code:
def irr_pm(net_profit):
    """IRR per month.

    The monthly rate at which net profit has a present value of zero.

    Units: rate per month
    Timing: whole projection
    Format: rate
    """
    return irr(net_profit)

irr_pa.label: IRR per annum
irr_pa.spec: The monthly IRR compounded to a year.

source.code:
def irr_pa(irr_pm):
    """IRR per annum.

    The monthly IRR compounded to a year.

    Units: rate per annum
    Timing: whole projection
    Format: irr
    """
    return (1 + irr_pm) ** 12 - 1
